role: current main assistant; prior gate developer, protocol preparer and execution coordinator; separate conversation from each DeepSeek generator
relationship: already saw the input and previous candidate, authored bounded gate rules and reviewed deterministic delivery; not independent human or blind review

sections.test_preservation: compare changed tests, assertions, helper/skip/build tags and actual events
sections.change_coverage: review every production diff and call chain against pinned spec; unsupported changes remain unknown
sections.delivery_evidence: check report statements, configuration/log provenance, candidate identities and unresolved issues

recording: actual reviewer, RFC3339 activity time, reason, file/spec/log locations; no prefilled conclusions; unknown without evidence
fallback: no silent substitution; unavailable reviewer is a recorded deviation and unresolved result
